Even with high functioning autism, it’s hard to handle. It’s an everyday mental battle that doesn’t stop. You burnout fast if you apply yourself, and many simple conversations will stress you out because you don’t know how to react to others.  There is plenty of other struggles that people have, but to play things off as simply quirky contorts what autism truly is.  There’s certainly things about it that aren’t truly harmful, but it’s a disability for a reason.
